# Contributors


## Special thanks for all the people who have helped with this project so far:
* [Reece Appling](https://github.com/reeceappling) - The one who wanted to build this in the first place, and has been working on it since the beginning.
* [Daniel Marquard](https://github.com/danielmarquard) - Bouncing ideas off of, giving feedback, and helping with the project outside of the code itself.

## I would like to join this list. How can I help the project?

I am not actively accepting outside contributions at this time, but I would consider accepting constructive changes to the system.

Contributions for the following *may* be considered:

- [ ] Bug fixes
- [ ] Novel, useful features that are not already on the roadmap
- [ ] etc...

For more information, please refer to the [CONTRIBUTING](CONTRIBUTING.md) guide.
